title: Samsung targets fivefold increase in V9 NAND capacity in China
html: Samsung Electronics plans to boost production capacity for its ninth-generation (V9) NAND flash memory fivefold at its second plant in Xi'an, China, by November 2027 to meet demand for enterprise solid-state drives (eSSDs) used in AI data centers, Seoul...
